title: Broadband Speed Degradation and Wi-Fi Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnostic protocols for customer reports of degraded download/upload speeds, latency jitter, and internal Wi-Fi interference.

sections.heading: Minimum Guaranteed Speed Thresholds
sections.text: NexusTel guarantees minimum wired throughput of 80% of advertised tier: Fiber 100 minimum 80 Mbps; Fiber 500 minimum 400 Mbps; Fiber Gigabit Pro minimum 800 Mbps. Testing must be conducted via Cat6 ethernet directly connected to NexusHub LAN Port 1 with background downloads halted.

sections.heading: Wi-Fi Frequency & Channel Optimization
sections.text: The NexusHub broadcasts dual-band 2.4GHz (extended range, max 90 Mbps real-world) and 5GHz/6GHz (high-speed, short range). High-density environments experience co-channel interference. Instruct customer to enable 'Smart Wi-Fi Channel Steering' or separate SSID bands in NexusTel app.

sections.heading: Hardware Limitation Diagnostics
sections.text: If customer operates a legacy NexusHub Basic (Wi-Fi 5 / 802.11ac) on a Fiber 500 or Gigabit tier, hardware throughput saturation will bottleneck wireless connections to ~220-300 Mbps. A router upgrade to NexusHub WiFi-6 is recommended.
